QuestInfo.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Present
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #p100# the fisherman again in #m10000000#. This time, he wants to get his wife #t4031043#s for her birthday and asked me to get #b20 #t4031043#s#k for him. Apparently, the scent of #t4031043#s lasts for over 500 years... #p100# told me that they can be found in the same place as last time, the #p609#. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN??
QuestInfo.2: I got #p100# all #b20 #t4031043#s#k. They do have a nice scent, but 20 of them? Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, #p100# gave me a nice glove he found inside the ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left their glove there... Is he allowed to give it to me like that? What if I wear it around town and run into its actual owner??

0.0: Ohhhh, you're the one that helped me out the other day. You look much stronger now. How's traveling these days? I actually have another favor to ask you... This time, my wife's birthday is coming up, and I need more flowers. Can you get them for me?

yes.0: Thank you! This time, I'd like to give my wife #b#t4031043#s#k... They have a very pleasant scent, and I heard they're found deep in the forest... They say the place where they exist doesn't let everyone in; only a selected few, I think. Something about a #p609# in #m10005000# and something-something...
yes.1: Please get me #b20 #t4031043#s#k. I think 20 will cover the house with that pleasant scent. Please hurry!

no.0: I understand... But my wife's birthday is coming up, and I am screwed! Please come back if you have some spare time.

1.0: Ohhh... You got me #b20 #b#t4031043#s#k! This is awesome... I can't believe you went deep into the forest and got these flowers... there's a story about this flower that says it supposedly doesn't die for 500 years. With this, I can make the whole house smell like flowers.
1.1: Oh, and... since you worked hard for me, I should reward you well. I found this glove in the ship. Some travelers leave things here and there. It looks like something you might need, so take it.

yes.0: If you have time, why not try going back into the forest? You might find some treasure in there. I can't guarantee it, since I've obviously never been there before, so please don't come back complaining to me if all you find is trash.

item.0: You haven't gotten the #b#t4031043#s#k yet. There's a #p609# in #m10005000# and I heard that with that you can go to the place where the #t4031043#s#k are. Please go into the forest and collect the #t4031043#s#k for me. I need 20 to make my wife's birthday present.
